_about: Director layout for V07 page 13. Units: pt, origin top-left. Tara's briefing at the map, a close beat on the empty mount, then the wide two-job briefing that closes the scene.

panels.compose: Medium view from beside the stand: empty Bell stand at frame-left, Tara centre, pointing her right index finger at the wall map at frame-right (map in the middle-lower right). Upper-right 60% x 34% calm (dark wall, vines, night sky) for a five-line caption.

Close three-quarter view, portrait frame. The vacant ring and slack rope in the upper half; Tara left of it, fingertips on the ring's lower edge, worried eyes on the empty hanging point. Bottom 22% calm (dark robe / shadow) for a three-line caption.

Eye-level medium-wide briefing. Ahana left, Vihaan centre-left, Navya centre, the empty stand centre-right, Tara right of it; map and dark Lantern Street arch at frame-right. Upper-left 58% x 32% calm (night sky / court wall) for a four-line caption; heads below 36% of the frame height.
